name: 3D Print
description: Put the bodies of your part on your printer's bed, lay them flat, arrange them and send them to the printer, with no exporting. Sends over USB, or to Klipper, OctoPrint or PrusaLink on your network. CadCraft's basic slicer comes with it; Kiri:Moto, PrusaSlicer and OrcaSlicer are add-ons of their own.
author: CadCraft
